objects.name: Analytic 2257
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies an SSH authentication/session to an ICS Linux asset from a VPN-assigned or remote-access source outside the approved remote-administration baseline. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the account/device/session violates the approved identity + source host/jump path/zone policy and is corroborated by access to a protected OT asset, execution, configuration change, or another security-relevant follow-on event. Suppress approved shift activity, vendor support, break-glass use, commissioning, and documented remote-access windows.

x_mitre_log_source_references.name: syslog:auth
x_mitre_log_source_references.channel: Secure Shell (SSH) session from Virtual Private Network (VPN)-assigned Internet Protocol (IP) address correlated with remote access authentication anomaly

x_mitre_mutable_elements.description: Documented geographic regions/ASNs from which legitimate ICS-role remote access is expected.
Baseline of normal session timing/duration for each ICS-role account's remote access usage.
Time window correlating VPN authentication with subsequent ICS-zone network access.
